input: Write a detailed itinerary for my solo Japan trip

gold.taskTitle: Plan a detailed solo Japan trip itinerary
gold.taskDescription: Create a detailed day-by-day itinerary for the user's solo trip to Japan.

questions.title: What are your exact travel dates or trip duration?
questions.description: Understand the length of the trip and specific dates to plan the itinerary accurately.

questions.title: Which cities or regions in Japan do you want to visit?
questions.description: Identify the specific destinations the user wants to include in their itinerary.

questions.title: What is your total budget for this trip?
questions.description: Understand the financial constraints to recommend appropriate accommodations, transport, and activities.

questions.title: What kind of experiences matter most to you?
questions.description: Determine the user's primary interests such as culture, food, nature, anime, nightlife, or history.

questions.title: Have you been to Japan before, or is this your first visit?
questions.description: Gauge familiarity with Japan to tailor the itinerary toward classic highlights or off-the-beaten-path experiences.

questions.title: What is your preferred pace of travel each day?
questions.description: Find out if the user prefers a packed schedule with many stops or a relaxed pace with fewer activities.

questions.title: Do you have any dietary restrictions or mobility considerations?
questions.description: Identify any personal constraints that would affect restaurant choices, walking distances, or activity recommendations.
